learning_outcomes.text: Possess an in-depth knowledge of the fundamental principles of business economics.
Gain skills in financial statement analysis, costing methods, and industrial investment evaluation.
Apply acquired knowledge in real business contexts, preparing, reading, and analyzing financial statements, calculating product/service costs, and assessing investment project feasibility.
Critically evaluate a company’s overall performance, analyze financial data, and determine the viability of certain products or investment projects.
Acquire specific terminology of business economics and communicate key content both orally and in writing, presenting results of economic analyses and evaluations clearly.
Independently deepen knowledge of business economics by consulting specialized texts, scientific journals, and other resources beyond class topics.

syllabus_topics: The firm and the business system
Classification of costs based on their behavior
Contribution margin and the relationships between income and volume
Cost determination systems for job-order and process costing
Alternative methods to NPV (Net Present Value)
teaching_methods: Provision of slides and materials on Elly platform
In-person teaching (with alternative hybrid/online modes for health emergencies)

assessment_methods.method: Written exam (Part Two: open-ended theoretical and practical questions)
First Midterm Exam (alternative for attending students)
Second Midterm Exam (alternative for attending students)

assessment_rules: The final assessment is a written exam divided into two parts. Part One, consisting of multiple-choice questions, requires at least 50% plus one correct answer to access Part Two, with no penalty for incorrect answers. Part Two comprises 4 to 6 open-ended questions. Attending students may opt for two midterm exams as an alternative to the final written exam; passing the first midterm grants automatic admission to the second. Final grades for the written exam are communicated via the Esse3 platform, and midterm grades via the Elly platform.
bibliography: Economia e Organizzazione Aziendale (a.a. 2025-26, Barbara Bigliardi, Create McGrawHill – ISBN 9781307678376
Slides presented during the lessons, texts of exercises with solutions, and other supplementary materials uploaded weekly to the Elly platform.
